skills.name: autonomous-variations
skills.summary: Builds four different takes on one part of your app at once, one session each, and opens a lab to flip through them.

skills.name: autonomous-prototypes
skills.summary: Makes a change in your own repo, tests it in the integrated browser, then ships it: a PR, a merge and a live GitHub Pages link.

skills.name: autonomous-demos
skills.summary: Records a short narrated video of your real app, with captions, ready for the page for everyone.

skills.name: autonomous-computer-use
skills.summary: Lets the agent use desktop apps like Notes or Notepad in the background. It never sends or buys anything.

skills.name: autonomous-runs
skills.summary: Keeps a long or overnight run going on your laptop: a status file, the laptop kept awake, checkpoints and a morning report.

skills.name: autonomous-research
skills.summary: Drafts a user study and turns results into findings with real quotes. It never launches a study or needs keys.

skills.name: my-taste
skills.summary: Learns your design taste from your own sessions and notes, and applies it when you ask for a review or a polish pass.
